name: TeslrBot
description: Gives you a conversational line to your Tesla, either here in Grok or publicly on X once you've linked up at teslr.club. Authentication happens by signing in on the bot's own machine, so there's no API token to extract and paste across.

official.title: TeslrBot by HeresMyEth
official.description: Talk to your Tesla in Grok. Connect at connect.teslr.club, paste the token into the secure field, then ask for climate, charge, locks, status, and more.
